violations.text: The door to the outside, located in the service area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The walls in the mop closet are constructed of drywall. This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (can opener) were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. Can opener taken out of service to be cleaned and sanitized. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

Peppers, which were prepared in advance, was not cooled to 70 degrees Fahrenheit in 2 hours and then to 41 degrees Fahrenheit within 4 hours. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

Proper cooling methods were not used for time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Per observation, salsa and cooked peppers were placed hot in the refrigerator in containers greater than four inches deep. Salsa was placed in shallow contianers; peppers were disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026

The door to the outside, located in the service area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The open-air case in the service area was observed in poor repair, with cracked vents and holding an ambient temperature of 46 degrees. The Agua Health water dispenser was observed with a leak. PIC placed work order with maintenance. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -black cart -open-air case vents. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The ceiling air vents and the floors in the dry storage area have an accumulation of soil residue and food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 10/08/2026
Several wall tiles (especially in service area) were observed cracked or missing. Ceiling tile in kitchen hallway was observed with a hole. New Violation. Correct By: 10/22/2026

The walls in the mop closet are constructed of drywall (the wall where mops hang dry). This material is not durable. Materials for wall surfaces shall be smooth, durable, easily cleanable, and non-absorbent for areas subject to moisture such as food preparation areas, walk-in refrigerators, ware-washing areas, and toilet rooms. New Violation. Correct By: 12/31/2026

Turkey, chicken, ham, broccoli, brussels sprouts, and cauliflower observed held at 46-48 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Items were voluntarily disposed of by PIC. Discussed not overfilling the refrigerators to allow air circulation, and not placing items into the refrigerators until it was 41 degrees F or below. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2024
Numerous food containers have an accumulation of paper and adhesive. New Violation. Correct By: 11/07/2024
The ceiling light near the dry storage room was not functional during inspection. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/14/2024
Wood cutting board on the line observed not in good repair, with a crack running through it. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2023
The non-food contact surfaces of the can opener base have an accumulation of food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2023
The dumpster area has an accumulation of leaf litter. Dumpster areas must be maintained clean to prevent harborage conditions for pests. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2023

The walls in the mop room are in poor repair, constructed on 2 sides by drywall, with the painted blocks on the third wall peeling. There is also a drainage pipe of unknown origin coming out of the wall to drain into the mop sink. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2024
